A global bank standing up its India technology and operations centre has reached a size where the centre needs its own governance rhythm rather than borrowing the parent entity's, and Flexiple, a managed marketplace placing specialist talent inside global companies' India teams, has been asked to help hire the person who will build it.
 



**Governance for a centre finding its own footing** 




 You would support the India centre's local board and governance committees end to end: preparing agendas and board packs, drafting minutes and resolutions, maintaining statutory registers, and coordinating the filings the centre owes to the Registrar of Companies and other authorities. You would also track compliance with the Companies Act and applicable Reserve Bank of India governance requirements for the centre's legal entity, and work with the global governance team to make sure local reporting lines up with what the parent entity expects.
 



**Where the gaps currently sit** 



* Board pack preparation is done ad hoc by whoever has time, with no fixed template or timeline
* Statutory registers have not been consistently updated as the centre has grown
* There is no single person accountable for the centre's Companies Act compliance calendar



**The profile we are hiring for** 



* 3 to 7 years in corporate governance or company secretarial work, ideally at a bank, financial\-services company, or large corporate
* A Company Secretary qualification, or an LLB with hands\-on governance and secretarial experience
* Working knowledge of Companies Act requirements and ROC filing processes
* Comfort setting up process where none currently exists, and working with both local and global stakeholders



 Location: Mumbai, Chennai, Hyderabad — hybrid, based alongside the centre's leadership and legal team
 



 Expect an HR screening, a working round on a governance\-calendar exercise, and a closing round with centre leadership.
 



 Flexiple keeps this application active for this role and future governance openings that fit your background.

We welcome all applications regardless of race, colour, religion or belief, gender, gender identity, age, national origin, marital status, military veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation and physical or mental disability.
 




**The Role** 





 The Contract Analyst is responsible for managing client contracts and building relationships both with our clients and across the business.
 



 This position is business partnering with one of our Business Units.
 



 This is a hybrid working role reporting to a Commercial Affairs Manager.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




 Business Partnering
 


* Foster excellent relationships with internal stakeholders.
* Provides regular status updates.



 Contract Management
 


* Collaborate with legal and agency teams to draft, review, and finalize contracts with clients in a timely manner.
* Ensures contracts meet quality and commercial standards.


* Manages the contract lifecycle using the HighQ system ensuring contracts repository is kept up to date.
* Supports business and clients with contracting questions


* Understands key operational and financial drivers of allocated Business Unit
* Works simultaneously on multiple contracts and contract amendments



 Business Metrics
 


* Track, manage and improve contract related metrics that demonstrate customer service.



 Relationship Management
 


* Build and maintain strong relationships with clients and business partners to ensure customer satisfaction and foster long\-term collaborations.



 Problem Solving
 


* Analyse information to solve problems and present proposed solutions to Management with Manager support.



 Communication and Negotiation
 


* Demonstrate strong communication and negotiation skills in engagements with internal teams and external clients.
* Effectively convey complex information and negotiate deals that align with the company's objectives.



**What skills and experience you bring to the role** 




* Keen eye for detail
* Excellent organizational, negotiation and communication skills
* Ability to solve problems, analyse information and achieve quality standards
* Good understanding of contract language
* Good analytical skills.
* Flexible and able to operate in a dynamic, fast paced environment
* Minimum of a bachelor’s level degree
* Proven experience in a commercial affairs / contracting role. Some background in working with Life Sciences / Pharmaceutical industry is preferable



**Who are Inizio?** 





 We help our clients navigate their clinical development and commercialization journey by connecting the best scientific knowledge, market intelligence, actionable data, technology, communication, and creative execution.
 



 With a global presence and multiple career paths, the career possibilities are expanding at Inizio. We’re a growing global team of 11,700 \- a $1\.5bn revenue business working with the world’s leading health and life sciences businesses, and we have exciting growth plans. Whoever and wherever you are, we’ll empower you with the autonomy you need to experiment, learn, and grow. We’ll make sure that you feel valued, supported and, of course, because we’re helping our clients to transform healthcare and improve millions of lives you can feel pride in your work at Inizio.

If you're excited about this role, but your experience doesn't perfectly fit every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this role or others.*

description:
**Job Description**
**Job Overview:**
 The Contracts Management Specialist manages and delivers Contracts Management activities across global projects utilizing existing practices to resolve routine and moderately complex commercial issues while ensuring alignment with contractual obligations.
   

  

 They are required to take ownership of contracts administration across all project phases, working with guidance and direction from seniors within the team, while proactively coordinating with multi\-disciplinary teams on large scale projects.
   

  

 The role offers continued professional growth through hands\-on project involvement, exposure to complex contractual scenarios, and opportunities for advanced development and training within the contracts management discipline
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Key Tasks and Responsibilities:**
* Drive the on\-time delivery of the projects that McDermott execute.
* Independently support the Contracts Management team of various projects on contract related matters, escalating critical issues appropriately.
* Implementing procedural requirements relevant to project contracts management – ensuring contractual compliance and project adherence to relevant contractual procedures.
* Documentation control, compliance tracking and reporting.
* Support in the development of material for the overall Contracts Management organization, including material for the centralized Portal to serve as a central repository for the global organization working on projects worldwide,
* Ensure maintenance of data schedules, contract records and support in reporting requirements.
* Record contractual correspondence and draft notices – coordinate with project management and other disciplines to ascertain facts and supporting information.
* Develop dashboards, reports and KPIs related to contractual performance
* Contribute to in pre\-contract activities to support in development of projects prior to award.
* Identifying, assessing, reviewing, and reporting contractual risks for individual items under the project contracts.
* Coordinate Change management, Claims and Disputes (evaluation of schedule and cost impacts, coordination and documentation).
* Review and monitor subcontractors and suppliers contractual compliance, documentation and records.
* Manage contractual communications with Vendors and Subcontractors
* Develop interface relationships with project supply chains and the interlinks between various contracts/subcontracts.

**Essential Qualifications and Education:**
* Bachelor's / Post Graduate Degree with background in Contract Management, Quantity Surveying, Construction Management or Engineering.
* It is preferable to have five to eight (5\-8\) years exposure of working experience in Contracts Management or similar experience and roles in EPC energy or infrastructure projects, construction or subcontract management.
* Fluent in the creation and editing of all Microsoft Office Suite documents.
* Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to interact and build relationships with more senior employees and multi\-discipline and multi\-national teams and gain respect from others.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong numerical and data analytical skills.
* Team player with a demonstrated ability to work effectively both independently and within a team.
* Diligent and highly motivated with strong analytical and problem solving skills with ability to pay attention to details and maintain accuracy in assessing, quantifying and resolving matters.
* Ability to present and articulate complex situations and circumstances to stakeholders with varying backgrounds.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks in parallel, and manage time effectively to achieve project goals.
* Strong contract acumen and awareness with an ability to assess variables and determine the optimum outcome.
* Willingness to learn new concepts and adapt to new challenges, and understand the wider perspective of project execution and contracts management.
* Ability to work in a global environment with different nationalities and ethnicities.
* Ability to thrive under pressure and use initiative.
* Willing to contribute to a collaborative and supportive atmosphere, actively seeking learning opportunities, and demonstrating a positive attitude towards work and colleagues.


**About Us**
 Our ingenuity fuels daily life. Together, we’ve forged some of the most trusted partnerships across the energy value chain to make what was once just an idea a reality: laying subsea infrastructure thousands of feet below sea level, installing platforms hundreds of miles from shore, using our expertise to design and build offshore wind infrastructure, and reshaping the onshore landscape to deliver the energy products the world needs safely and sustainably.

**Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of overall experience in CLM, contract management, legal operations, or enterprise system implementations

* Experience leading enterprise or multi\-region CLM implementations
* Prior experience working with global clients and distributed teams


 Functional \& Domain Expertise
   

  

* Strong understanding of:
+ Contract authoring and negotiation processes
+ Clause and template management
+ Buy\-side and sell\-side contracting models
+ Obligation, compliance, and performance management

* Ability to translate complex legal and commercial requirements into system workflows


**Skills**
* Excellent communication and stakeholder facilitation skills
* Strong documentation skills (BRDs, functional design documents, user stories)
* Ability to work independently in a remote delivery model
* Comfortable collaborating across time zones and cultures


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Sirion CLM certifications or formal product training
* Experience with integrations (ERP, CRM, eSignature, OCR, third\-party systems)
* Consulting or system integrator background
* Exposure to regulated industries (BFSI, Life Sciences, Energy, Telecom, Technology)
